title: Accelerating Last Stand - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Accelerating Last Stand in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Accelerating Last Stand is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Gain Rush if fighting alone.

sections.title: How to Get Accelerating Last Stand
Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
